title: Lighthouse Roadmap Brief: Compact mid-month exec sync and contingency asks
creator: Oliver Kim
description: A compact, one-page ‘lighthouse’ briefing intended for mid-month executive syncs. Purpose: surface signal-to-decision items for roadmap lanes (runtime optimization, Dedicated capacity, Private deployment) with concise telemetry, current confidence bands, near-term asks, and contingency lanes. Designed to be read in 5 minutes and used as the single source for quick decisions between monthly QBRs. Contains a short scenario matrix (best / baseline / stress) and explicit canary rollback triggers for the next 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: Single-page PDF produced and uploaded to Confluence
Telemetry snapshots (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, error-rate) for each initiative included
Two contingency asks clearly articulated with owner and budget estimate
Executive reviewer sign-off recorded in comments

2026-03-11 — Rodrigo Mendes (CPO): Requested clearer success metrics for the canary rollback trigger. Suggested using sustained 15% regression over baseline for 10 minutes as a trigger.
decision_log: 2026-03-05 — Decided to prioritize a single lighthouse brief per month (mid-month) instead of multiple ad-hoc slides to reduce executive noise.
2026-03-07 — Approved two contingency asks: (1) 2-week burst GPU pool at 30% budget premium; (2) $75k pilot for dynamic quantization of the top-3 high-throughput models.
2026-03-11 — Canary rollback trigger approved as: sustained p95 increase >15% vs baseline for >=10 minutes OR token error-rate >0.3% for 5 minutes. Owners assigned to ENG-SRE and Runtime teams.
2026-03-12 — Format decision: single-page PDF + 3-slide appendix for follow-up questions.
